fields.summary: With milestone 14 the last one queued, the orchestrator planned milestone 15 under the owner's standing instruction. The new feed is drowned by actor records: of its first 1,000 items, 869 are 'Record agent actor' record change sets that write a single actor node, so filtering on kind alone would be wrong (records also carry plans and links). And every what-if read folds the whole log: Index.WhatIf runs foldStored over all entries (93% of its time in a profile: row scan 56%, FoldLog 32%, decode 11%), taking about 0.45 s on this repo against 0.02 s for an as-is read with a warm index, and 1.6 s on the 50k-node benchmark. Folding only the in-flight change sets a what-if needs over the stored as-is rows removes the scan; meeting the 50 ms budget for what-if reads would further need a SQL overlay reader and stays in the older proposed change set 01M5SWTFB3.
fields.title: Milestone 15: the feed shows the work, what-if reads stop rereading the log
